src/components/form/ImageUpload/hooks/useFileUpload.ts mimeTypeOf keeps file.type only when it starts with image/, otherwise maps the extension, so an application/octet-stream .png/.webp is accepted. Covered by useFileUpload tests.

LogoUploadPanel.tsx handleInputChange ignores edits to the displayed name while a stored workflow icon token is held; only clearing the box or pasting an http(s):// URL changes the value. New LogoUploadPanel.test.tsx covers edit, clear/paste and the no-token case (commit 7eabb0c16).
